description: Repository-side admission contract for #1473. This validates the shape and structural separation of an externally administered verifier boundary without treating repository-authored claims as proof of independent administration.

input_requirements.boundary_descriptor_location: absolute regular file outside PlanGate repository
input_requirements.signer_repository: must differ from PlanGate and from the attestation repository
input_requirements.signer_workflow: exact workflow path under the signer repository
input_requirements.receipt_contract: must match the #1471 external verifier receipt domain/stage
input_requirements.admin_separation_evidence: three required external HTTPS Evidence classes (administrator-separation-attestation, signer-identity-attestation, nonce-lifecycle-policy), each with a distinct SHA-256 digest; PlanGate repository references, credentials, query strings, and fragments are rejected after URI normalization

negative_controls: PlanGate repository used as external signer
PlanGate repository URL used as independent-admin Evidence, including case/percent-encoding variants
missing required Evidence class or duplicate-type Evidence set

next_gate.requirement: Create the external admin boundary and independently verify the referenced administrator-separation Evidence before promoting any strong machine-attestation field.
